title: Reward Points Falling Due on a Purchase by a Circle Member
content:
## When points fall due on a purchase

Reward points earned on a purchase fall due on the Northbeam Circle Membership the profile holds, and this
schedule governs one figure: the points booked for that earning occasion, together with the spend they were
earned on.

## What the booking does to the record

The membership ledger gains an earning entry carrying the points earned, the spend they were earned on, which
earning occasion produced them, the purchase they belong to and the tier the membership stands at, and the
reward point balance shown on the membership goes up by those points. The member sees the points on the
membership and can spend them from that balance.

## How the points are booked

`book_purchase_points_235cc6ac` is the desk's own tool: it is unlocked and then called by the agent handling
the membership.

## Parameters

- `membership_id` — the reference number of the Circle membership the points are earned on, read from the
  membership record returned when the membership is looked up.
- `points_earned` — the reward points earned on this occasion, in whole points, signed, passed as a positive
  whole number of points with no decimal part and no thousands separator; it is stored as an integer count of
  points at exactly that precision.
- `qualifying_spend_usd` — the spend those points were earned on, in USD to 2 decimal places, a positive
  amount rounded half to even at the cent, with no unit symbol.
- `accrual_basis` — which earning occasion produced these points, exactly one of: `store_purchase`,
  merchandise bought at a store counter; `online_purchase`, merchandise bought through the web or mobile
  storefront; `protection_plan_purchase`, a ShieldCare protection plan bought by the member; `service_visit`,
  a TechWorks visit or bench session the member paid for; `trade_in_bonus`, points that go with a Renew
  trade-in; `promotional_event`, a promotion run for members over a named period; `goodwill_adjustment`,
  points put on or taken off the balance to put something right.
- `source_order_id` — the reference number of the purchase, plan or work order the points were earned on,
  read from that order record before the call.

## What comes back

A confirmation line naming the membership, the points booked, the qualifying spend they were earned on, the
earning occasion recorded, the order they belong to and the reference number of the new earning entry; the
presence of that earning entry reference is what marks the call as completed.
